info.title: Brave Search API
info.description: The Brave Search API provides access to Brave's independent search index for web, image, video, and news results, along with local POI data, autocomplete suggestions, and spellcheck. All endpoints require an API key passed via the X-Subscription-Token header.

get.description: Search the web using Brave's independent search index. Returns web page results with titles, URLs, snippets, and optional rich data enrichments such as weather, stocks, and calculator results. Supports search operators, custom re-ranking via Goggles, and location-aware results.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return per page. Maximum value is 20.

parameters.name: text_decorations
parameters.description: Whether to include decoration markers (e.g. bold) in text results.

parameters.name: result_filter
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of result types to include. Possible values include: discussions, faq, infobox, news, query, summarizer, videos, web, locations.

parameters.name: goggles_id
parameters.description: URL of a Goggles definition file to apply custom re-ranking rules to search results.

parameters.name: extra_snippets
parameters.description: When true, provides up to 5 additional alternative excerpts per search result.

get.description: Search for images across the web. Returns image results with thumbnails, dimensions, source URLs, and publisher information. Supports up to 200 results per request.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of image results to return. Maximum value is 200.

parameters.name: safesearch
parameters.description: Content filtering level for image results.

get.description: Search for videos across platforms and sources. Returns video results with metadata including titles, URLs, thumbnails, and duration information.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of video results to return per page. Maximum value is 50.

get.description: Search for recent news articles. Returns news results with titles, URLs, descriptions, publication dates, and source information. Supports date-based freshness filtering and extra snippets.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of news results to return per page. Maximum value is 50.

parameters.name: extra_snippets
parameters.description: When true, provides up to 5 additional alternative excerpts per news result.

parameters.name: goggles_id
parameters.description: URL of a Goggles definition file to apply custom re-ranking rules to news results.

get.description: Retrieve detailed information for local points of interest by their temporary IDs. POI IDs are obtained from web search results containing location data and expire after approximately 8 hours. Accepts up to 20 IDs per request.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Array of temporary POI identifiers obtained from web search location results. Maximum of 20 IDs per request.

get.description: Retrieve AI-generated descriptions for local points of interest by their temporary IDs. POI IDs are obtained from web search results containing location data and expire after approximately 8 hours. Accepts up to 20 IDs per request.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Array of temporary POI identifiers obtained from web search location results. Maximum of 20 IDs per request.

get.description: Get intelligent query autocompletion and search suggestions with typo resilience and contextual adaptation. Optionally return rich metadata including entity titles, descriptions, and images.

parameters.name: rich
parameters.description: When true, enables enhanced metadata in suggestions including titles, descriptions, and images for entity-type suggestions.

get.description: Check a search query for spelling errors and receive correction suggestions. Returns intelligent corrections based on query context and search patterns. When spelling is correct, the results array is empty.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-Subscription-Token
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key for authenticating requests. Obtain from the Brave Search API dashboard.

q.name: q
q.description: The search query string. Supports search operators such as quoted phrases, minus for exclusion, site:, and filetype:.

country.name: country
country.description: Two-character country code to target search results geographically (e.g. US, GB, DE). Use ALL for worldwide results.

search_lang.name: search_lang
search_lang.description: Language code in ISO 639-1 format to filter results by content language (e.g. en, fr, de).

ui_lang.name: ui_lang
ui_lang.description: Language for the response UI/metadata strings.

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset for the results page. Maximum value is 9.

safesearch.name: safesearch
safesearch.description: Content filtering level for search results.

freshness.name: freshness
freshness.description: Filter results by discovery time. Predefined values: pd (past 24 hours), pw (past week), pm (past month), py (past year). Custom range format: YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD.

spellcheck.name: spellcheck
spellcheck.description: Whether to enable automatic spelling corrections for the query.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response from the Brave Search API.

altered.description: The altered/corrected query if spellcheck was applied.

spellcheck_off.description: Whether spellcheck was disabled for this query.

more_results_available.description: Indicates whether more result pages are available for pagination.

title.description: The title of the web page.

url.description: The URL of the web page.

description.description: A text snippet or excerpt from the web page.

extra_snippets.description: Up to 5 additional alternative excerpts from the page. Only present when extra_snippets parameter is enabled.

is_source_local.description: Whether the source is from the target country.

is_source_both.description: Whether the source is available in both local and global contexts.

page_age.description: The estimated publication or last-updated date of the page.

page_fetched.description: The date the page was last fetched by the Brave crawler.

meta_url.description: Metadata about the URL including scheme, netloc, hostname, favicon, and path.

thumbnail.description: Thumbnail image associated with the result.

deep_results.description: Deep results including buttons and social profiles.

WebSearchResponse.description: Response from the web search endpoint.

family_friendly.description: Whether the entire result set is family-friendly.

discussions.description: Forum and discussion results related to the query.

faq.description: Frequently asked questions related to the query.

infobox.description: Information box with structured data about the query subject.

videos.description: Video results found in web search.

locations.description: Local business/location results related to the query. Contains temporary POI IDs that expire after approximately 8 hours.

news.description: News results related to the query.

rich.description: Rich data enrichment such as weather, stocks, calculator, currency conversion, and more.

vertical.description: Type of rich result (e.g. weather, stock, calculator, currency, crypto, definitions, unit_conversion, unix_timestamp, package_tracker).

callback_key.description: Key to use when fetching detailed rich result data.

mixed.description: Ordering information for blending different result types.

index.description: Index into the corresponding result array.

all.description: Whether all results of this type should be inserted.

title.description: Title or caption for the image.

url.description: URL of the page containing the image.

page_fetched.description: Date the page was last fetched.

thumbnail.description: Thumbnail version of the image (500px width, aspect ratio maintained).

width.description: Width of the original image in pixels.

height.description: Height of the original image in pixels.

ImageSearchResponse.description: Response from the image search endpoint.

description.description: Text description or summary of the video.

age.description: Human-readable age of the video (e.g. '3 days ago').

page_fetched.description: Date the video page was last fetched.

duration.description: Duration of the video in ISO 8601 or human-readable format.

creator.description: Creator or uploader of the video.

publisher.description: Platform or publisher of the video.

VideoSearchResponse.description: Response from the video search endpoint.

description.description: Summary or excerpt of the news article.

extra_snippets.description: Up to 5 additional alternative excerpts. Only present when extra_snippets parameter is enabled.

age.description: Human-readable age of the article (e.g. '2 hours ago').

page_fetched.description: Date the article was last fetched.

breaking.description: Whether the article is marked as breaking news.

name.description: Name of the news source or publisher.

NewsSearchResponse.description: Response from the news search endpoint.

id.description: Temporary POI identifier. Expires after approximately 8 hours. Use with /local/pois and /local/descriptions endpoints.

provider_url.description: URL to the provider listing page.

LocalPOIResponse.description: Response from the local POI details endpoint.

LocalDescriptionsResponse.description: Response from the local descriptions endpoint.

results.description: Array of AI-generated descriptions for requested POIs.

is_entity.description: Whether the suggestion represents a specific entity. Only present in rich mode.

title.description: Entity or topic title. Only present in rich mode.

description.description: Contextual description. Only present in rich mode.

img.description: URL to an associated image. Only present in rich mode.

query.description: The corrected version of the query.

SpellcheckResponse.description: Response from the spellcheck endpoint. When spelling is correct, the results array is empty.

results.description: Array of correction suggestions. Empty when the query is spelled correctly.

BadRequest.description: Bad request. The query parameters are invalid or missing required fields.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized. The API key is missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden. The API key does not have access to the requested resource or endpoint.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. The API rate limit has been exceeded. Retry after the period indicated in the response headers.
